name: 🎨 ☄️ [BEAM-COLORS] Mr Hood
desc:
Purely made by HorrorCC!

** YOU CAN NOW MACRO **

Macro: Use the greet animation and enable the button, press one of the keys to move.

Mr Hood is a simplistic-challenging game based on Da Hood.

Some helpful tips can be read below:
・Obtain kills with BULLET-WEAPONS ONLY!
・Gamepasses, can make your gameplay better/more unique
・(weapons can be collected by players or purchased)
・Food is a great way to boost health in battle
・Using certain animations could help you in battle
・Collecting crates can have overpowered weapons
・Private servers give you special access to do things

・Commands:
/e skin #
/e fov #

Account needs to be at least 15 days old

💎 Made by HorrorCC
